facts.text: I am looking to sell some of my vintage items.
I have a vintage 1960s Omega Seamaster watch that is worth around $5,000 according to an appraiser.
I am considering selling a rare 1980s-era Sony Walkman Professional.
I have a first edition of The Avengers #1 from 1963 that I am considering selling.
I have a near-mint condition Batman action figure from the 1960s that I am considering selling.
I am considering selling my vintage 1960s Fender Jazzmaster guitar.
My vintage 1960s Fender Jazzmaster guitar was appraised by a local music store for $3,000.
I have a lot of experience with photography.
I have never taken photos of high-end items like these before.
I am thinking of getting my vintage Omega Seamaster watch serviced and authenticated by Omega themselves.
I am considering selling a rare 1950s-era Cuban peso note.
I think my rare 1950s-era Cuban peso note could be worth a few hundred dollars.
